What is compensation management software and what does it actually do? Compensation management software helps organizations structure jobs, benchmark pay against market data, plan salary and merit decisions, review pay equity, and communicate total rewards. CompBldr connects these workflows so HR and Finance can work from consistent job, market, planning, and reporting data instead of managing each step in disconnected spreadsheets or tools. What is the difference between compensation management software and an HRIS? An HRIS, such as Workday, BambooHR, or ADP, is built to store and manage employee records: headcount, payroll, benefits administration, and basic compensation data. How do I identify and fix pay equity issues in my organization? Identifying and fixing pay equity issues requires three things working in sequence. First, a consistent job architecture so you are analyzing compensation across roles that are genuinely equivalent in scope, level, and responsibility. Second, reliable market benchmarking so you have an external reference for what fair pay looks like for each role and level. Third, a structured demographic analysis of your current pay data, looking at comp-ratios, range penetration, and pay outcomes by gender, ethnicity, tenure, and level to identify where systemic disparities exist. What do pay transparency laws require, and how do I make sure we're compliant? Pay-transparency requirements vary by jurisdiction and can change over time. Organizations should confirm the rules that apply to their locations and workforce. CompBldr can support the compensation work behind transparency programs by helping teams maintain job structures, salary ranges, benchmarking records, and documented review workflows; it does not determine legal compliance. How do you build salary bands that are actually competitive? Building salary bands typically combines internal job evaluation, external market data, and a clear pay-positioning strategy. CompBldr supports these connected workflows so teams can review role structure, use the market-data sources they select and license, and apply their compensation strategy consistently across job families, levels, and geographies. How long does it take to implement compensation management software? Implementation timing depends on organization size, data readiness, selected modules, integrations, configuration, and the scope of job architecture or benchmarking work. CompBldr can begin with existing compensation data and progressively structure it inside the platform. The implementation team supports data migration and initial configuration, and compensation consulting support is available when job architecture or related design work is part of the project. How does CompBldr compare to tools like Payfactors, Pave, or Radford? Market-data providers supply compensation survey data. CompBldr is designed to connect selected market data with job architecture, evaluation, planning, analytics, reporting, and total rewards workflows. A confidence score (0–1,000) indicates the relative strength of a blended market figure based on configured inputs such as source coverage, match quality, and sample size. What is a match quality badge in the Sources tab? Match quality badges rate how closely a survey title aligns with an organizational position. Exact (green) means direct alignment. Strong (blue) means closely related with minor scope differences. Partial (yellow) means overlapping but with meaningful scope variation. Match quality affects how each comparator is weighted in the blended market calculation for that position. What is an aging factor in salary benchmarking? An aging factor adjusts survey compensation data for the time elapsed since the survey's effective date. Frequently Asked Questions What is a total rewards statement builder? A total rewards statement builder helps HR teams design and populate personalized compensation statements using structured employee data. CompBldr brings template selection, statement design, data review, cycle management, and review steps into one connected workflow. How many statement templates does CompBldr include? CompBldr includes nine pre-built, professionally designed templates. Each template shows a thumbnail preview, a block count badge, style tags, and a Best-for label describing the employee population it suits. Clicking any template opens a full, scrollable preview with sample compensation data already populated before HR commits to a design. Can different employees receive different statement templates in the same cycle? Yes. CompBldr supports per-employee template assignment within a single cycle. An executive cohort and a general workforce cohort can receive purpose-designed statements from one production run. Each statement renders with that employee's actual compensation data from the Data Manager in the template assigned to them. How does AI column mapping work during data import? After uploading an Excel or CSV file, HR teams can review how spreadsheet columns map to statement data fields and confirm the mapping before the imported information is used in a statement cycle. Fields that need attention can be reviewed before proceeding. What compensation data categories does the Data Manager support? The Data Manager organizes employee compensation across five categories: Personal Information, Base Earnings, Employer-Provided Benefits, Additional Earnings, and Statutory Figures. Each employee's full field values are stored in a grid that HR can review and edit individually before the cycle runs and statements are generated. What is a cycle in the Total Rewards Builder? A cycle defines the time period and participant list for a statement production run. HR sets a Cycle ID, name, and type: Fiscal Year (dates auto-calculate from organizational settings) or Custom Period (manual date entry). Each cycle stores its own template assignments, data snapshot, and approval record independently. Can HR approve statements in bulk? CompBldr provides statement review workflows that let HR teams review participant statements and control release timing. Available approval options can depend on the configured workflow, so teams should confirm the review and release process during implementation. What format are distributed statements delivered in? Approved statements can be exported as print-ready PDF files, one per employee, using the reviewed statement layout. HR controls when those files are downloaded or released through the organization's chosen distribution process, and approval status remains associated with the cycle record. What block types are available in the statement builder? The builder includes eight block types: chart blocks supporting single or multiple side-by-side charts, data table blocks with configurable columns and totals, text blocks, branding blocks, summary cards, spacers, dividers, and custom content areas. Blocks are added by drag, reordered by drag, and configured in the right-side panel.
